name: katharsis
description: An output style that classifies each message by exchange type and shapes the reply to fit it: the answer first, a ceiling per type, reference codes that survive the session, and decisions handed back as questions

autonomy.title: Autonomy level
autonomy.description: Which actions Claude takes without asking you first, when it cannot infer your answer from what you said, your repo's conventions, or preferences you stated earlier. guided (default): every push, PR, and message to a colleague is your call. standard: further publishing inside a scope you approved this session goes ahead, such as another push to a branch you approved pushing; starting something new that publishes stays your call. autonomous: everything standard allows, plus pushing a branch the work created and opening or updating a PR from it, once the work is verified; never the default branch, someone else's branch, or a PR against a repo you can't push to, or that PR's branch. At every level, merging, deleting data Claude did not create this session, any force-push, spending money, and messaging people, including a PR comment, review reply, or review request, stay your call.

richness.title: Richness level
richness.description: text (default): replies as without this option. sketch: a plain-text sketch of up to 12 lines when a list or table can't show a shape. rich: as sketch, plus Claude Motion animations when offered and that option is on.

motion.title: Claude Motion
motion.description: On: at rich, animate with Claude Motion when offered, as a private artifact that counts against plan usage. Off: keeps Motion out of Katharsis replies.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Draw the Katharsis band above the prompt: a row naming how many codes of each type the session holds, with an open button for the drawer and a list of each type's latest titles on hover. Off by default, since the row shares the space above the prompt with other plugins. Without it, /kdrawer and the rows under each reply open the drawer.
